environment.description: Same Kubernetes deployment but with an Istio service mesh sidecar (v1.20+) configured with an EnvoyFilter resource that applies a Lua-based header mutation policy on the inbound listener chain for port 50051. The filter inspects gRPC HEADERS frames and strips any metadata key matching the pattern '^x-script-' before forwarding to the application container. Additionally, the RemoteScriptLoader is compiled with a build-time constant FETCH_ALLOWLIST pointing to an OPA sidecar (port 8181) that evaluates rego policy 'data.artifacts.fetch_allowed' which only permits URLs matching 'https://artifacts.internal.corp/ci/*'. The OPA policy bundle is signed and loaded via cosign-verified OCI artifact from the internal registry. The SRI hash verification in the audit log is promoted to enforcement mode via the environment variable PIPELINE_SRI_MODE=enforce, which causes _execute_in_sandbox to abort if the computed hash doesn't match a pinned manifest stored in a read-only ConfigMap (ci-script-hashes) mounted at /etc/pipeline/sri-manifest.json.

typed_config.inline_code: function envoy_on_request(handle) local headers = handle:headers() for key, _ in pairs(headers) do if string.match(key, '^x%-script%-') then handle:headers():remove(key) end end end
